subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Counting (integrated with number patterns and mental maths)
source.subtopic: Count forwards and backwards in 1s from any number between 0 and 180 (weeks 1-4) and 200 (weeks 5-10)

show.line: Big numbers! One hundred and ninety-eight, one hundred and ninety-nine, two hundred! Let's count up to two hundred.

rounds.prompt: Count on. One hundred and fifty-seven, one hundred and fifty-eight. What comes next?
Look at this number. Say it.
Count on. One hundred and ninety-eight, one hundred and ninety-nine. What comes next?
Which number comes just before one hundred and eighty?
Count backwards. One hundred and sixty-two, one hundred and sixty-one. What comes next?
Tap the number one hundred and eighty-six.
Which number is greater, one hundred and forty-five or one hundred and ninety?
rounds.praise: One hundred and ninety is greater.

hints: Say one hundred and, then count on with the small number.
After one hundred and ninety-nine comes two hundred.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count on from one hundred and sixty-eight.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One hundred and sixty-eight, one hundred and sixty-nine, one hundred and eighty!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! After one hundred and sixty-nine comes one hundred and seventy.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Sixty-eight, sixty-nine, seventy. One hundred and seventy!

parent_line: Can count forwards and backwards in ones up to 200.
